notes: The municipal newspaper reports the February 2013 Russian winter-track championship at Samara-Ring in Kurumoch. The complete oval footprint is independently digitized from the June 15, 2013 Landsat 8 panchromatic scene, before subsequent site redevelopment. Field roads, access roads and the oval infield are excluded. The 15 m native ground resolution, exact UTM transform, source DN clip, rendering stretch, scene identity and hashes are pinned. Nearest-neighbor rendering does not add resolution. The oval centerline is a historical draft; winter snow barriers, precise racing-line placement and direction remain unverified. No vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing positions or nominal distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 1473.8 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
